title: Create Numismatics: Craftable Coins
description: This mod adds craftable coins to create numismatics
body:
This mod adds a crafting recipe for the Spur, this is intended for small comunities or servers,

To craft a spur you can add 8 Copper Sheets into the crafting table, and a single iron ingot in the middle as shown below:

![Crafting recipe for the Spur](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efd1553b30e13926927df95e72ea1e5bcacc5103.png)

To craft a Bevel You must first take a iron nugget, then deploy a Zinc ingot twice then press twice, then deploy a Nugget of Xp. As shown below:

![Crafting recipe for the Bevel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5969bafd7cfe93ec79bcf90376f4dbf3e63acccc.png)

Dependencies:

Create 6.0.10

Create Numismatics 1.0.20
